title: Even or Odd
story: if and else decide. The remainder operator % tells you what is left over.
goal: Write Parity(n int) string returning even or odd.
hints: if n%2 == 0 { return "even" } then return "odd" after the if.
socratic: Does Go need parentheses around the if condition?
